facts.related_party_note: The Company has formulated a Policy on Related Party Transactions in accordance with the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. All related party transactions are placed before the Audit Committee for its review and approval. Omnibus approval is also obtained from the Audit Committee for repetitive transactions. The particulars of Related Party Transactions are disclosed in the Notes forming part of the Financial Statements and in Form AOC-2 (Annexure VII).
